repo.description: Watched repository as owner/name — the PRODUCT repo whose merges trigger doc syncs. REQUIRED per deployment. Drives the webhook repo filter.

webhook_secret_env.description: Env var holding this repo's webhook HMAC secret — the BUPHA_WH_<OWNER>_<REPO> convention (uppercased, '-' → '_'). REQUIRED per deployment; the var must exist in the campaign service env (~/.config/peregrin/env or cuora).

checkout.description: Local clone path of the DOCS repo lasius operates on — worktrees are created off it and the docs PR is opened against it. REQUIRED per deployment.

product_checkout.description: Local clone path of the PRODUCT repo — read-only source of truth for the agent (product main is fetched here) and the repo arg for `lasius forge pr view`. REQUIRED per deployment.

worktree_base.description: Run state (run-<sha>/), docs worktrees (wt-<sha>/), the global .sync-lock, session ids, and the cleanup ledger land here.

base_branch.description: Product base branch a merge must target to trigger a sync (payload.base_ref check) and the ref fetched as the sync point.

agent.description: sepia agent-config id for sync sessions.

agent_mode.description: ACP session mode applied via session/set_mode. REQUIRED for unattended runs — devin's default accept-edits prompts on exec and deadlocks. 'bypass' auto-approves all tools; 'smart' auto-runs model-judged-safe actions; 'accept-edits' only auto-approves edits.

lasius_root.description: lasius workspace root (--root flag); repo args are checkout paths so any lasius.toml workspace works.
